notes.title: Update 0.0.47 - Balancing
notes.notes:
[u][b]First: remeber to leave any kind of feedback here to participate in the key giveaway. It ends in a few days! :)[/b][/u]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]

[list]
[*] The last enemy attack would still hit the player even if the enemy had just died.
[*] For certain heros, particularly the Priest, the attack range was not updated when switching skills.
[*] The Priest’s level-up now displays the correct image in the tavern.
[*] The Samurai’s level-up now displays the correct image in the tavern.
[*] The Paladin’s level-up now displays the correct image in the tavern.
[*] Hero names in the unlocks screen are now correctly shown when hovering over them.
[*] Enemies no longer move during their death animation.
[*] Scrolling was deactivated when the mouse hovered over specific areas of the screen due to invisible RichText labels from Godot, which prevented scrolling. This is also fixed now.
[*] The Paladin sprite no longer becomes invisible when the level 3 skill is active.
[/list]

[b]Buffs:[/b]

[list]
[*] Imp: Hit chance increased to 75%.
[*] The Priest now has more durability and attacks faster.
[*] The Paladin has slightly more health and defense.
[*] The Paladin’s level 2 skill now causes a knockback effect, as long as the enemy doesn’t die instantly.
[*] The Druid’s level 3 skills have been improved.
[/list]

[b]By the way, have you ever wondered what 150 carrots look like in the tavern?[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45076747/0a02ac54c3dfa58edf10b4ce710aa3778a59e7c7.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 0.0.46 - Balancing / Small Additions
notes.notes:
[u][b]First: remeber to leave any kind of feedback here to participate in the key giveaway. It ends in a few days! :)[/b][/u]

[b]Improvements:[/b]

[b]Level Cap:[/b]

[list]
[*] Prevented players from reaching level 4 by setting the required experience points extremely high. The current level cap is 3, but it will be increased in future updates.
[/list]

[b]Enhanced Selection Menu:[/b]

[list]
[*] Added short descriptions for heroes in the selection menu for starting heroes.
[*] Included information about each hero's favorite food in the selection menu.
[/list]

[b]Notification Removal:[/b]

[list]
[*] Removed the message about potential appearances at Wayfarer's Firepit, as unlocked units now appear there daily (see below for details).
[/list]

[b]Buffs/Nerfs:[/b]

[b]Wayfarer's Firepit Changes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Once unlocked, Wayfarer's Firepit now contains new units every day, provided at least one unit has been unlocked.
[*] Each unit can only be hired once per run. Note: Many more heroes will be available to unlock in future updates.
[*] Reduced the initial unlock cost for Wayfarer's Firepit to 2 gold.
[/list]

[b]Building Cost Adjustments:[/b]

[list]
[*] Lumberjack now requires 3 gold to build.
[*] Stone Mine now requires 4 wood to build.
[*] Tavern now requires 3 gold to build.
[/list]

[b]Unit Cost Changes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Hiring Goblins now costs only 3 gold.
[*] Reduced the cost to buy units at Wayfarer's Firepit to 3 gold. Note: In future updates, different units will cost different resources.
[/list]

Many thanks to all players that gave balancing feedback, especially [b]Rhagon[/b].
